patterns.note: The hero section features a full-bleed, intimate portrait image of a person, with large, elegant typography overlaid centrally.
A large, elegant serif font is used for primary hero messaging, creating a luxurious and editorial feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for UI elements.
The color palette is muted and natural, drawing from the hero image's soft tones, with white text for high contrast and dark grey/blue for subtle UI elements.
As the user scrolls, a product showcase card animates into view from the center of the screen, expanding to overlay the hero text while the background image remains static.
The primary content delivery mechanism for product display is an overlay card that appears over the hero, rather than distinct scroll-triggered sections.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered overlay effect, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll, where a product card animates into view and expands over the main hero content as the user scrolls. This creates a focused reveal without transitioning to a new page section.
The hero section uses a large, high-resolution portrait image as a full-bleed background, with text placed directly on top, relying on the image's natural light areas for text legibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif for hero headings (~4x body) with a lighter weight, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for smaller UI text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements and content cards, maintaining a soft, refined aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open in the hero section, creating a sense of calm and focus, with balanced spacing for smaller UI elements like the cookie banner.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an intimate, full-bleed portrait as the hero image, combined with elegant serif typography and a subtle, scroll-triggered product overlay, creates a highly personal and luxurious brand experience that feels more editorial than transactional.
